=== Heroes: Abathur ===
[Updates]
  Talents:
  • Level 4
    • Slapathur
      • [Undocumented] The same Hero or Structure can only be Stunned or disabled once every 8 seconds.
      • [Undocumented] Unstoppable Heroes can now be Stunned by it.
[Bug Fixes]
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Slapathur to not have an animation for Stunned enemies and disabled Structures.

  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Slapathur to Stun enemies while Blinded or if the target is Evading.
  • [Undocumented] Fixed an issue causing Abathur's Slapathur to disable Structures while Blinded.
